---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible game integration, runner or result issue
---

Describe expected and observed behavior, plus steps to reproduce.

Include source revision, OS/Python/game versions, task ID/version, model and
controller mode. Attach a redacted result/error and relevant log excerpt.
State whether the failure happened during preparation, the task or finalization.

Do not include API keys, game binaries or unrelated local data.
